<p>*Release date: 2014-03-28* On March 28, 2014, Li Lixin, Chairman and Sales Manager of Changsha Sharpen New Materials Co., Ltd., and Li Zi, among others, brought the company's main products high-performance diamond grinding wheel and CBN grinding wheel to attend this exhibition. Sharpen New Materials has an excellent R&D team led by a leading figure in China's superhard materials field, holding multiple independent intellectual property rights, R&D and production of world-class quality cermet bond diamond grinding wheel and CBN grinding wheel. After extensive market application, it can completely replace similar imported grinding wheels! The key is that the strong R&D team can timely provide enterprises with a complete technical solution for grinding and polishing cemented carbide and high-speed steel cutting tools. The exhibition site was crowded with people, many old and new customers visited and consulted at our company's booth. The new cermet bond grinding wheel launched by Sharpen, due to its independent edge breaking, high shape retention and easy dressing characteristics, attracted wide attention from many cemented carbide processing enterprises. On the afternoon of the 28th, Professor He Yuehui held a lecture titled 'New System of High-Performance Ti(C,N)-based Cermet Materials and Diamond Grinding Wheels for Grinding Processing' in the second meeting room of the exhibition, with unique and professional content, winning several rounds of applause.</p>
